summary_1line: Rama organizes the monkey army’s march south; they traverse forests and mountains and finally reach the ocean, halting to plan how to cross to Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama rides on Hanuman’s shoulders in the center of the roaring monkey army as thousands leap through forests brandishing uprooted trees.
From the summit of Mount Mahendra, Rama looks out over the immense ocean filled with waves, sharks, and turtles under the rising moon.
The vast monkey host camps along the seashore while the turbulent ocean roars, waves crashing as night falls and the moon reflects across the water.
